tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: All measured parameters are within normal limits except for a mildly decreased total carbon dioxide, which may suggest mild metabolic acidosis or compensated respiratory alkalosis. Renal function, electrolytes, and glucose are normal. Correlation with clinical context and further evaluation may be considered if symptoms are present.
